reads.headline: Manchester City 55.7% away favourites at Aston Villa
reads.summary: Manchester City are clear favourites at Aston Villa in Saturday's Premier League game, 55.7% to win. The market rates City about three-quarters of a goal better than Villa, a handicap line of 0.77. The draw is 22.6%, rated above a Villa win at 21.6%, so a tight Villa Park is seen as more likely than a home victory. Goals are the other part of the picture: the total is 3.09, Over 3.0 has moved from 50.3% to 52.2%, and both teams to score is 60.5%. An open, high-scoring game with City on top.

reads.headline: Barcelona 59.4% favourites, but Madrid are closing the gap
reads.summary: Barcelona are clear favourites for Sunday's Clasico at the Camp Nou, with a 59.4% chance to win. Real Madrid have gained ground, though: their win chance has risen from 19.8% to 24.1%. Barcelona are still rated about one goal better on the handicap at -1.02. The draw is the least likely result at 16.5%. The market expects a high-scoring game: the fair goals total is now 4.18, up from 4.03. Both teams to score is rated 73.2%, so clean sheets are not the expectation.

The goals side has moved the other way, with the fair total up to 4.18 and over 4.25 close to a coin flip at 48.4% — both teams to score is rated 73.2%, while the draw is the outsider at 16.5%.

reads.headline: Roma narrow favourites for the trip to Napoli
reads.summary: Roma are narrow favourites for Saturday's Serie A trip to Napoli, at 37.8%, with Napoli close behind on 34.4% — a small margin, not a clear one. The handicap is level: the market rates Roma just 0.07 of a goal better, so this is close to a coin-flip game. Napoli are without first-choice centre-back Alessandro Buongiorno, out with a knee problem, and Roma also miss defender M. Bah. Over 2.5 goals is 50.9% — a genuinely split goals game. Both teams to score is 56.1%, and the draw, at 27.7%, is the least likely result.
reads.read: Napoli's win chance has been trimmed upward in recent days while Roma drifted, and with the goals line sitting exactly on 2.5 this is priced as a tight, close-to-even game between two sides each missing a defender.

reads.headline: Juventus 60.7% favourites at home to Rennes
reads.summary: Juventus are clear 60.7% favourites for Thursday's Europa League home game against Rennes in Turin. The market rates them about a goal better, on a handicap line of -1. The draw is 22.0%, above a Rennes win at 17.3%. Juventus are missing key attackers, including Yildiz, while Rennes list Lepaul as doubtful with an ankle problem. The goals line is 2.75, and over is 51.2% — the market sees roughly three goals. Both teams to score is 53.3%, so Rennes are more likely than not to find the net. Rennes +1 at 51.7% makes a narrow Juventus win close to even.
reads.read: Juventus are clear 60.7% favourites in Turin, rated about a full goal better than Rennes on a handicap line of -0.94. The market expects roughly three goals and makes both teams to score more likely than not, while pricing Rennes +1 at 51.7% — a one-goal home win is no more than a coin flip.

reads.headline: Levante vs Athletic: a flat board and a sharp split
reads.summary: Athletic Club are clear favourites at 43.7% fair against Levante's 25.5%, with the draw at 30.8%. Over 2.5 is frozen at 49.1%, with a fair total of 2.47; both teams to score is slightly favoured at 53.3%. Four injury names — three Levante, one Athletic — produced no visible reaction after our first report at 00:55, though there is no earlier baseline.
